liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Eyes Of The World** (2 reviews): Called a wicked version; A really beautiful version arrives after Stella Blue, when the show seemed finished [12][15]
- **Morning Dew** (2 reviews): Some lyrics missed, but the seamless transition into Uncle John's Band is a highlight; Peaks within the Playin'/Uncle John's chunk [16][18]
- **Uncle John's Band** (2 reviews): Harmonies are unusually polished here, described as studio-like and among the band's best singing; Described as flawless, with impressive reprises after Morning Dew [10][12]
- **Playing In The Band** (2 reviews): The Playing, Uncle John's Band, Morning Dew, Playing sequence is picked for the reviewer's own '73 compilation; Jerry starts the jam meandering and less aggressively, then builds to full power with Jerry leading [10][14]
- **Here Comes Sunshine** (1 review): Singled out as a particularly strong performance, with consistent energy and musicianship throughout the show [8]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): The China Cat into I Know You Rider pairing is named as a standout [8]
- **Brown Eyed Women** (1 review): Named as a first-set highlight [16]

## The recordings

- **gd1973-11-17.sbd.patched.bec.22799.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 30 songs; 233 min; rated 3.75/5 by 4 [1]
- **gd1973-11-17.166358.aud.Conner.gems.flac1648**: audience recording; 27 songs; 197 min [2]
- **gd1973-11-17.sbd.ashley.23472.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 25 songs; 184 min; rated 5/5 by 22 [4]. Said about its sound: Source distortion exists, worst on Looks Like Rain, present before the 2004 remastering [4]
- **gd73-11-17.sbd.gardner.4749.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 25 songs; 184 min; rated 4.69/5 by 51 [5]. Said about its sound: Described as crisp and clean sound; Slight hiss; high-frequency treble can be turned down easily to fix it; Sound is described as awesome [9][16][17]

## Around the show

- The reviewer first heard the show as a low-quality 40K online stream before getting the lossless SHN copy [8]
- Played at UCLA; reviewer imagines students there becoming Deadheads after seeing it [13]
- Taper was on the floor level, right side seats [2]
- Splice sits between Ramble On Rose and Playin' in the Band, with no music affected [5]
- Reviewer asks whether the band ever played a Playin' sandwich and Eyes into Sugar Magnolia like this before or since [13]
- The Playin' jam is less aggressive than at Veneta and earlier Berkeley Community shows [14]
- First set is hot but not over the top for the period; the second set is far stronger [15]
- Has the songs expected from this period, though no Dark Star combination [18]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1973-11-17.sbd.patched.bec.22799.flac16**: source: SHNID 19896 and 4762 [1]. Also: Patched soundboard; several tracks, including Uncle John's Band, Eyes and Casey Jones, have short DAT patches covering gaps [1]
- **gd1973-11-17.166358.aud.Conner.gems.flac1648**: taped by Recorded by Charles Conner from floor level seats on the right side; transferred by Transfer of re-shelled master cassettes on November 15, 2023 using a Nakamichi CR-7A > Tascam DA-3000 @ 24 bit 96 kHz and mastering on November 16, 2023 by Jim Blackwood Speed/pitch adjusted by Jason Chastain; source: Sony ECM-22P mic (mono) > Sony TC-55 > BASF C90 master cassettes [2]. Also: First audience recording of this show to circulate, by Conner; shared on the 50th anniversary, with no tape-flip patching [2]
- **gd1973-11-17.sbd.ashley.23472.sbefail.shnf**: transferred by Jay Ashley; source: SBD>>MR>>CASS>>DAT>>CDA>>WAV(EAC)>>SHN [4]. Also: Remastered April 5, 2004 on a custom dual-DAW called Bertha, with noise reduction and cleaned track transitions [4]
- **gd73-11-17.sbd.gardner.4749.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [5]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Bob Marks Grateful Dead: [1973-11-17 Pauley Pavilion, UCLA, Los Angeles, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1973-11-17-pauley-pavilion-ucla-los-angeles-ca-usa/) [21]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Pauley Pavilion - November 17, 1973](https://www.dead.net/show/november-17-1973) [22]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Special Collections - Dave's Picks](https://store.dead.net/collections/special-collections-daves-picks) [23]
- Poster by RareVinyl.com: [Grateful Dead Dave's Picks Volume 5: Pauley Pavilion, UCLA, Los Angeles, CA 11/17/73 2012 US 3-CD set](https://us.rarevinyl.com/products/grateful-dead-dave-s-picks-volume-5-pauley-pavilion-ucla-los-angeles-ca-11-17-73-us-3-cd-album-triple-set-r2532995-790398) [24]
- Poster by disasteramnesiac.blogspot.com: [Grateful Dead-Dave's Picks v. 5; Pauley Pavilion, UCLA 11/17/1973](https://disasteramnesiac.blogspot.com/2013/02/grateful-dead-daves-picks-v-5-pauley.html) [25]
